# NTULearn MCP

> Read-only MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for NTULearn, NTU Singapore's Blackboard Learn (Ultra). MCP clients such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor can list a student's courses, browse content, read course files as text (pptx with speaker notes, pdf, docx, xlsx), read lecture recordings as timestamped transcripts from their captions, see deadlines, announcements and grades, and sync course files to disk. Sign-in goes through NTU's SSO and MFA in a real browser window, with no API key. Forked from Mattlo0546/blackboard-mcp. Python, MIT licence.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): setup, client config, tools, settings, privacy
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): code layout and NTULearn behaviour checked against the live site

## Tools
- bb_login, bb_status, bb_courses, bb_browse, bb_read, bb_download, bb_upcoming, bb_announcements, bb_grades, bb_recordings, bb_transcript, bb_sync / bb_sync_status, bb_set_courses

## Upstream
- [blackboard-mcp](https://github.com/Mattlo0546/blackboard-mcp): the generic Blackboard Learn server this fork is based on
